thread:
Sam: SOS  neighbor mulching the lawn during our 10am sync and my laptop mic picks up every pebble. desperate for a quick fix that doesn't involve buying another mic. :sweat_smile:
Vera: Rug under the laptop + lower mic gain. also try moving the laptop closer to you and turn on background noise suppression in the call app.
Jon: if you can get an ethernet to the living room, bathroom, or wherever the router is, tethering over USB is way more stable than wifi hotspot for quick calls. flat cable under the door is reversible.
Sam: i can't run cable across the living room, roommate will riot. any sound-blocking hacks that don't look like a bunker?
Priya: try a folded blanket behind you on a chair as a wall. plants help visually but not much for mulch mower low freq. a small rug on the desk reduces vibrations.
Vera: small foam headphones cover your laptop mic with a cloth over it (don't cook your laptop). or use phone in airplane mode + earbud mic (often isolates better).
Jon: speakerphone in another room + headset near you works too. weird but effective.
ops-bot: FYI: building community room open until 12:00 today if you need a quieter spot. check https://internal/locations for availability. :bell:
Sam: thanks all. quick duct-tape + towel temporary shield and switching to phone-earbud for the sync. if it works i'll reward the thread with a photo of my towel-fort. :camera_with_flash:
